difficulty_reason: Prove the diagonal of Picardfunctor_{X/B} over B is a quasi-compact immersion: it is an immersion by the Quot-chapter diagonal lemma (quot-lemma-diagonal-pic); quasi-compactness is argued in-span - the diagonal of the Picard stack is affine of finite presentation (lemma-pic-diagonal-affine-fp), the stack is a gerbe over the functor (lemma-pic-gerbe-over-pic-functor), and the gerbe-diagonal-quasi-compact lemma transfers quasi-compactness of the stack diagonal to the functor diagonal.
